## Preview your changes

1. Edit your copy or replace an image, then click **Save**. This saves a draft.
2. When the build finishes, open or refresh the preview. The **Draft preview** label shows which revision you are viewing. [Open the site preview](https://ipancaldi.github.io/disguise-sales-pitch/preview/) · [Check build status](https://github.com/ipancaldi/disguise-sales-pitch/actions/workflows/publish.yml)
3. Review the page on desktop and mobile.

## Publish a reviewed draft

Send the preview link and its revision to your publisher. With GitHub write access, you can open a publishing pull request, check that its latest commit matches the preview label, then select **Create a merge commit** to update the live site. [Open a publishing pull request](https://github.com/ipancaldi/disguise-sales-pitch/compare/production...main?expand=1)

Anyone with the preview link can open it.
